extName.description: Extension name. Product name, do not translate.

extDescription.message: Preencha e copie credenciais do Ashy Pass, o gestor de palavras-passe para Linux.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the browser's extension list and in the store.

loading.description: Shown while the popup waits for the desktop app.

notInstalledTitle.message: O Ashy Pass não está ligado
notInstalledTitle.description: Title when the desktop app (native host) cannot be reached.

notInstalledBody.message: Instale o Ashy Pass e ligue este navegador em Ashy Pass → Definições → Navegador.
notInstalledBody.description: Explains how to connect the desktop app. 'Settings' and 'Browser' are the names of the app's settings page and section.

disabledTitle.message: A extensão do navegador está desativada
disabledTitle.description: Title when browser integration is disabled in the desktop app.

disabledBody.message: Ative a extensão do navegador em Ashy Pass → Definições → Navegador.
disabledBody.description: How to enable the browser integration in the desktop app.

noVaultTitle.description: Title when the user has not created a vault in the desktop app.

noVaultBody.message: Crie primeiro o seu cofre no Ashy Pass.
noVaultBody.description: Asks the user to create a vault in the desktop app.

retryButton.description: Button that retries connecting to the desktop app.

lockedTitle.description: Title above the master password field.

masterPasswordLabel.description: Label of the master password field.

unlocking.description: Shown while the vault is being unlocked.

badPassword.description: Error after a wrong master password.

rateLimited.message: Demasiadas tentativas. Aguarde um momento e tente novamente.
rateLimited.description: Error after too many wrong master passwords.

searchLabel.description: Label and placeholder of the search field.

searchResultsHeading.description: Heading of the list of search results.

noEntriesForSite.message: Não há credenciais guardadas para este site.
noEntriesForSite.description: Shown when no entry matches the current site.

noSearchResults.description: Shown when a search has no results.

notAWebPage.message: O preenchimento só funciona em páginas web.
notAWebPage.description: Shown when the current tab is not an http or https page.

noUsername.description: Shown in an entry row when the entry has no username.

untitled.description: Shown in an entry row when the entry has no title.

fillButton.description: Button that fills the login form on the page. Keep it short.

copyUsernameButton.description: Button that copies the username. Keep it short.

copyPasswordButton.description: Button that copies the password. Keep it short.

copyCodeButton.description: Button that copies the verification (TOTP) code. Keep it short.

fillLabel.description: Accessible label of the Fill button.

copyUsernameLabel.message: Copiar o nome de utilizador de $TITLE$
copyUsernameLabel.description: Accessible label of the Copy user button.

copyPasswordLabel.description: Accessible label of the Copy password button.

copyCodeLabel.message: Copiar o código de verificação de $TITLE$
copyCodeLabel.description: Accessible label of the Copy code button.

usernameCopied.description: Short confirmation after copying a username.

passwordCopied.description: Short confirmation after copying a password.

codeCopied.description: Short confirmation after copying a verification code.

filled.description: Short confirmation after filling a login form.

noLoginForm.message: Nenhum formulário de início de sessão encontrado nesta página
noLoginForm.description: Shown when the page has no field that can be filled.

copyFailed.message: Não foi possível copiar para a área de transferência
copyFailed.description: Shown when writing to the clipboard fails.

generateButton.description: Button that generates a new password and copies it.

revealPassword.description: Button that reveals the generated password.

hidePassword.description: Button that hides the generated password again.

vaultLocked.description: Short confirmation after locking the vault.

errorTimeout.message: O Ashy Pass não respondeu a tempo.
errorTimeout.description: Error when the desktop app takes too long to answer.

errorDisconnected.message: A ligação ao Ashy Pass foi perdida.
errorDisconnected.description: Error when the connection to the desktop app closes.

errorNoMatch.message: Esta credencial não pertence a este site.
errorNoMatch.description: Error when trying to fill an entry on a different site.

errorNotFound.description: Error when the entry was deleted.

errorNoTotp.message: Esta entrada não tem código de verificação.
errorNoTotp.description: Error when the entry has no TOTP secret.

errorCannotAccess.message: Esta página não permite o preenchimento.
errorCannotAccess.description: Error when the browser refuses to run the filler on the page.

errorDetail.description: Generic error with the English text sent by the desktop app.

backButton.description: Header button that goes back to the list.

addButton.description: Header button that adds a new login. Keep it short.

openAppButton.description: Button that brings up the Ashy Pass desktop app.

tabVault.description: Bottom tab and header title for the list of logins (the vault).

tabGenerator.description: Bottom tab and header title for the password generator.

tabSettings.description: Bottom tab and header title for the extension settings.

sectionsLabel.description: Accessible name of the bottom tab bar.

pinLabel.description: Label of the PIN field on the locked screen.

unlockWithPinButton.description: Button that unlocks the vault with the PIN.

useMasterPassword.description: Link that switches the locked screen from PIN to master password.

usePin.description: Link that switches the locked screen from master password to PIN.

badPinAttempts.description: Error after a wrong PIN, with the number of attempts left before the PIN is turned off.

pinDisabledNote.message: O PIN foi desativado após demasiadas tentativas erradas. Use a sua palavra-passe principal.
pinDisabledNote.description: Shown when the PIN can no longer be used.

pinUnavailableNote.message: Não há nenhum PIN configurado neste computador. Use a sua palavra-passe principal.
pinUnavailableNote.description: Shown when the PIN is not available.

inlineHintTitle.message: Mostrar sugestões nos campos de início de sessão?
inlineHintTitle.description: Title of a card that offers to turn on the suggestions inside the login fields of websites.

inlineHintBody.message: O Ashy Pass pode listar as suas credenciais logo abaixo dos campos de utilizador e palavra-passe dos sites.
inlineHintBody.description: Text of the card that offers inline suggestions.

enableButton.description: Button that turns a feature on.

folderFilterLabel.description: Accessible label of the folder filter.

typeFilterLabel.description: Accessible label of the item type filter.

filterWithCodes.description: Type filter option: only logins that have a verification (TOTP) code.

filterFavorites.description: Type filter option: only favorite logins.

noFolder.description: Folder filter option and value for logins that are not in a folder.

autofillSuggestions.description: Heading of the logins that belong to the current website.

allItemsHeading.description: Heading of the list with every login.

filteredHeading.description: Heading of the list when a filter is set.

noFilterResults.message: Nenhum item corresponde a estes filtros.
noFilterResults.description: Shown when the filters hide every login.

emptyVault.description: Shown when the vault has no logins.

viewDetailsLabel.description: Accessible label of a row in the list.

openWebsiteLabel.description: Accessible label of the Open website button of a row.

moreOptionsLabel.description: Accessible label of the ⋮ menu button of a row.

favoriteButton.description: Menu item that marks the login as favorite.

unfavoriteButton.description: Menu item that removes the favorite mark.

openWebsiteButton.description: Button that opens the login's website in a new tab.

copyWebsiteButton.description: Button that copies the login's website address.

viewDetailsButton.description: Menu item that shows the details of a login.

websiteCopied.description: Short confirmation after copying a website address.

addedToFavorites.description: Short confirmation after marking a favorite.

removedFromFavorites.description: Short confirmation after removing a favorite.

detailsTitle.description: Header title of the details view of a login.

totpLabel.description: Label of the time-based verification (TOTP) code.

websiteLabel.description: Label of the website address field.

nameLabel.description: Label of the name (title) field of a new login.

newLoginTitle.description: Header title of the view that adds a login.

saveButton.description: Button that saves a new login.

nameRequired.description: Error when the name of a new login is empty.

passwordRequired.description: Error when the password of a new login is empty.

saved.description: Short confirmation after saving a login.

passwordGenerated.description: Short confirmation after a password was generated into the form.

errorInvalid.message: O Ashy Pass não pôde aceitar este pedido.
errorInvalid.description: Error when the desktop app rejects a request as malformed.

regenerateButton.description: Button that generates a new value.

copyButton.description: Button that copies the generated value.

generatorTypeLabel.description: Accessible label of the Password / Passphrase / PIN switcher.

kindPassphrase.description: Generator type: passphrase made of words.

optAvoidAmbiguous.description: Generator option: leaves out characters that look alike (l, 1, O, 0).

wordsLabel.description: Label of the number of words of a passphrase.

separatorLabel.description: Label of the text placed between the words of a passphrase.

oneClassRequired.message: Mantenha pelo menos um tipo de carácter.
oneClassRequired.description: Shown when the user tries to turn off every character type.

fillOnPageButton.description: Button that fills the generated password into the password fields of the page.

noPasswordField.message: Nenhum campo de palavra-passe encontrado nesta página
noPasswordField.description: Shown when the page has no password field to fill.

lockNowButton.description: Settings button that locks the vault.

inlineSettingLabel.message: Mostrar sugestões nos campos de início de sessão
inlineSettingLabel.description: Settings switch that turns on the menu of logins under the login fields of websites.

inlineSettingHint.message: Requer acesso aos sites que visita. A página nunca vê as suas credenciais; nada é preenchido até escolher uma.
inlineSettingHint.description: Explains the permission needed by the inline suggestions.

inlineEnabledToast.message: Sugestões ativadas. Recarregue as páginas abertas para as ver.
inlineEnabledToast.description: Confirmation after turning on the inline suggestions.

permissionDenied.description: Shown when the browser permission request was refused.

shortcutLabel.description: Settings row that shows the shortcut that opens the extension.

shortcutHint.message: Abre esta janela. Pode alterá-lo nas definições de atalhos de extensões do navegador.

shortcutNotSet.description: Shown when no keyboard shortcut is set.

inlineMenuTitle.description: Accessible title of the suggestions menu shown under login fields.

inlineButtonLabel.description: Accessible label of the small Ashy Pass button inside login fields.

inlineLocked.description: Shown in the suggestions menu when the vault is locked.

inlineNoLogins.message: Não há credenciais para este site
inlineNoLogins.description: Shown in the suggestions menu when nothing matches the site.

addLoginButton.description: Button in the suggestions menu that adds a login for the site.

inlineClickIcon.message: Clique no ícone do Ashy Pass na barra de ferramentas para continuar.
inlineClickIcon.description: Shown when the extension window cannot be opened automatically.

inlineExpired.message: Este menu expirou. Clique novamente no campo.
inlineExpired.description: Shown when the suggestions menu can no longer be used.
